_readme: The FAQ page (/faq/ and /es/faq/), page-level words only; the questions and answers themselves are in src/_data/faq.json. en and es must have the same keys. Plain text. groups: the headings the questions are sorted under, in the order shown on the page; each key matches the group of the questions in faq.json (add a key in both languages to add a heading). jump.expandAll/collapseAll label the button that opens or closes every answer (shown only when JavaScript runs). closing: the line under the last question; its button is labelled with i18n contact.linkText and opens an email to the address in site.json (never written here).
